desc: The Versa-Tac Home Defense Gun Case's interior compartment has a gun securing strap and corner pockets to hold your gun in place. This case also has plenty of storage, with two external hook and loop closure pockets, one 16" x 10" pocket with elastic loops to hold MSR magazines, and one 14" x 10" pocket with elastic loops for shotgun shells. Made with rugged Endura fabric. Lockable zippers.
